issues.detail: The skill file contains extensive explanatory text that may be considered verbose.
Installation instructions assume a Unix-like shell, limiting cross-platform compatibility.

scenarios.name: http-fetch-and-extract
scenarios.rationale: Response A meets most rubric items but omits the required Fetcher.get settings, while Response B lacks all specified requirements.

scenarios.name: js-rendered-page-scrape
scenarios.rationale: Response A meets the DynamicFetcher requirements and performs the click and extraction, but omits the quote count; Response B uses Playwright instead of DynamicFetcher and lacks the required fetcher settings.

scenarios.name: full-crawl-with-spider
scenarios.rationale: Response A covers most rubric items but misses the exact 100-item count and uses a set for allowed_domains; Response B fails to meet several key requirements such as concurrency, delay, and the CrawlResult contract.
